sources.entry: tmpNote - Very simple macOS app to make temporary notes.

summary.one_liner: tmpNote is a simple macOS app for jotting down temporary notes, forked from Tyke.app with a global hotkey and launch-at-startup added.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short. It describes tmpNote as a fork of Tyke.app by @torrez with two stated improvements: a global hotkey and launching at system startup. The README says the app can be obtained from the Mac App Store. It gives no detail on the note editing interface, storage, or other features. The repository was listed under the Notes section of a list of open-source macOS apps.
use_cases: quick temporary notes on a Mac
note-taking opened with a keyboard shortcut
how_to_run: Install from the Mac App Store (per README)
notable: Global hotkey to open notes (from a fork of Tyke.app)
caveats: README is very brief; no documentation of features or build steps
Distributed via the Mac App Store per README; source build instructions not given
